steps.note: Grull Hawkwind in the middle of camp. Take The Hunt Begins.

steps.note: She sends you for a water pitcher from the same well.

steps.note: Plainstriders by the well: 7 feathers and 7 meat. Stay close to the well.
Fill the Water Pitcher at the well. The plainstriders are right beside it.
Hand the pitcher back to Chief Hawkwind in camp.

steps.note: Chief Hawkwind: next stop is Seer Graytongue, in the hills south of camp.

steps.note: Back to Grull for the reward and the next hunt.

Antur Fallow, west of camp, gives you a bundle of furs for Kauth in Bloodhoof.

steps.note: Seer Graytongue, in the hills south of camp.
steps.title: Rites of the Earthmother

steps.note: Twelve Bristleback Belts from the bristlebacks in Brambleblade Ravine, east of camp.

steps.note: Ten-minute timer. Carry the incense straight to the Ritual Fire.

steps.note: Shrine of An'she and Mu'sha: hand in at the Ritual Fire before the incense burns.

steps.note: Mountain Cougars around here. Ten pelts needed.
Back to Grull with the pelts.
steps.title: The Hunt Continues

steps.note: Grull: kill Battleboars and bring back 8 snouts and 8 flanks.
steps.title: The Battleboars

steps.note: Brave Windfeather: Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle (lvl 5) east of camp.
steps.title: Break Sharptusk!

steps.note: Battleboars around the east ridge. Snouts and flanks drop together.
Bristleback Belts from the quilboar and shamans in Brambleblade Ravine. 12 needed.
Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle, lvl 5. Pull him alone and bring back his head.
Back to Grull with the snouts and flanks.
steps.title: The Battleboars

steps.note: Sell grey items and repair at Kawnie Softbreeze before the north trip.
Chief Hawkwind: pick the best weapon for your class from the reward list.
steps.title: Rite of Strength

steps.note: Brave Windfeather: hand in the head. Pick the reward you can wear.
steps.title: Break Sharptusk!

steps.note: Chief Hawkwind: a breadcrumb. Take the Totem of Hawkwind to Baine Bloodhoof.
steps.title: Rites of the Earthmother

steps.note: Breadcrumb for the Forever campfire quest. Deliver the supply bundle to Kaga in Bloodhoof.
steps.title: The Adventurer

steps.note: Shamans: two applications of Ritual Salve from the bristleback shamans east of camp.
steps.title: Call of Earth

steps.note: Bristleback Shamans drop Ritual Salve. Two applications needed.
Back to Seer Ravenfeather with the salve.
steps.title: Call of Earth

steps.note: Shamans: take the Earth Sapta. Drink it at Kodo Rock in Mulgore.

steps.note: Minor Manifestation of Earth, just east of camp. Drink the Sapta first.

steps.note: Shamans: the Rough Quartz comes with the quest.

steps.note: Shamans: the Earth Totem is your first real class tool.

steps.note: Level 4 now: the class trainers stand around the inn. Learn your new spells here.
Mull Thunderhorn: six Prairie Wolf Paws and four Plainstrider Talons.
steps.title: Poison Water

steps.note: Harken Windtotem: eight Trophy Swoop Quills from the hills north of town.
steps.title: Swoop Hunting

steps.note: Yaw Sharpmane: kill Chakuyak in the west and bring back her pelt.
steps.title: Chakuyak

steps.note: Make Bloodhoof Village your home at Innkeeper Kauth before the north trip.
Bread and water for the north trip. Hunters: arrows from Moorat Longstride.
Krang Stonehoof: defeat three Novice Warriors. Cheap and right here.
steps.title: Sparring Match

steps.note: Kaga Wildhoof: deliver the supply bundle. Next is the campfire.
steps.title: The Adventurer

steps.note: Kaga: next, sit by the campfire until the Boosted Rest buff appears.
steps.title: The Great Outdoors

steps.note: Sit at Kaga's Basic Campfire and wait for Boosted Rest. Takes a minute.
Back to Kaga once you have the Boosted Rest buff.
steps.title: The Great Outdoors

steps.note: Kaga: the cooking camp quest. Pyall is next door.
steps.title: Camping 101: Cooking

steps.note: Pyall Silentstride: speak to him to learn the cooking camp item.
steps.title: Camping 101: Cooking

steps.note: Novice Warriors right here. Players in duels also count.
Back to Krang Stonehoof for the errand.
steps.title: Sparring Match

steps.note: Chakuyak is lvl 5-6, west of town. Pull her carefully.
Prairie Wolf Paws north of town. Plainstrider talons are nearby.
Swoops in the hills north of Bloodhoof. Pick off the small ones first.
Yaw Sharpmane: Chakuyak's pelt handed in.

steps.note: Mull: use the cleansing totem at the Winterhoof Water Well, south-east of town.

steps.note: Innkeeper Kauth: the bundle of furs goes here. Food and water reward.
